items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: I worked with P. Rowan's band even from time to time.

ctx.x: So you played with everybody just to know that. Right. Did you play much with Celestan? I played with Celestan a while.

I played with Celestan when Kildee and Ormond Franklin was in the band. Celestan stopped playing for a while. And I was the other man and he was directing, he would like to take care of the band in the front. I worked with P. Rowan's band even from time to time. It's in the days of the evening too.
Did you ever write any arrangements or anything by the way? I was wondering about that. Yeah, I used to write some.
